title: Miuccia Prada is worth $4.8 billion. How good of a...
content: Miuccia Prada is worth $4.8 billion. How good of a person do you expect her to be? “I got to thinking about all this the other day while mulling the curious, oft-repeated fact that Miuccia Prada was, in her 1960s youth, a Communist.”
author: Jason Kottke
